WITH RECURSIVE inheritance_tree AS (
  -- Seed: classes that directly name ApiModel in their class statement
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.base_name = 'ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  -- Recursive step: find classes that inherit from a class already in the tree
  SELECT s.symbol_id, it.depth + 1
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  JOIN inheritance_tree it ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.class_symbol_id
  WHERE s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM inheritance_tree)
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
FROM inheritance_tree
WHERE depth > 1
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id;

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
explanation: The recursive CTE first seeds the tree with classes that directly name ApiModel in their class statement (depth 1). It then repeatedly adds classes whose base_symbol_id matches a class already in the tree, incrementing depth. The final SELECT filters out the seed (depth > 1) so only indirect subclasses remain, and each row shows the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 means the parent directly subclasses ApiModel).

WITH RECURSIVE inheritance_tree AS (
  -- Seed: classes that directly name ApiModel in their class statement
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.base_name = 'ApiModel'
  UNION ALL
  -- Recursive step: find classes that inherit from a class already in the tree
  SELECT s.symbol_id, it.depth + 1
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  JOIN inheritance_tree it ON cb.base_symbol_id = it.class_symbol_id
  WHERE s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM inheritance_tree)
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, depth
FROM inheritance_tree
WHERE depth > 1
ORDER BY depth, class_symbol_id;
